summary: Today's full expanded plan covers 46 creative fields, adding cartography and robotic art before collection. This edition contains 36 first complete guides (including 22 promotions from the pending queue) and 39 additional screened discoveries. Together these add 53 new tool identities to the cumulative library; first inclusion does not mean newly launched software. Highlights span local creative workspaces, synthetic terrain, live captions, AI-assisted CAD, vector animation, notation and research reconstruction. Software licenses are reviewed separately from model weights, third-party assets, proprietary hosts and paid services. Every platform is considered equally; undocumented hardware/platform facts remain unknown. No discovered application was installed or run. All 326/326 repository queries and 16/16 model tasks were attempted; 0 repository queries failed, 0 were partial and 101 were bounded. Live primary-source web research supplements the collector. Codeberg and SourceHut access remains a disclosed gap. Raw search candidates are not verified recommendations; remaining promising work stays in the persistent review backlog.
